items.title: File Widerspruch against the Fahrtenbuchauflage
items.quote: Der Widerspruch muss binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Beispielförde, Kreishaus, Förder Straße 3, 24103 Beispielförde, erhoben werden.
items.computation: Sender is a Kreis (general administrative authority, not a Finanzamt), so the 4-day delivery fiction (posted on/after 1 Jan 2025 → deemed delivered on the 4th calendar day after posting) applies, but the deemed-delivery day is NOT shifted for weekends/holidays for a general authority. Posting day = letter date 29.09.2026 (Tue, no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date given). Counting 4 days: 30 Sep (1), 1 Oct (2), 2 Oct (3), 3 Oct (4) = Saturday 03.10.2026 → deemed Bekanntgabe = 03.10.2026 (not moved). The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 70 VwGO analogue for Kreisverwaltung) runs under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the delivery day itself is the reference day, the period ends on the day with the same number in the following month = 03.11.2026 (Tuesday). This day is neither a Saturday/Sunday nor a public holiday in Schleswig-Holstein, so no further shift applies (§ 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG/LVwG SH would only move it if it fell on such a day).

items.title: Fahrtenbuchauflage becomes final (Bestandskraft) and logbook duty starts
items.quote: Die Auflage beginnt mit Eintritt der Bestandskraft dieses Bescheides.
items.computation: The 6-month logbook duty starts only once the order becomes legally final (Bestandskraft), i.e. once the Widerspruch period expires unused. Assuming no Widerspruch is filed, Bestandskraft occurs the day after the Widerspruch deadline of 03.11.2026 expires, i.e. 04.11.2026. This is an estimate only: if a Widerspruch is filed, Bestandskraft (and thus the start of the logbook duty) is postponed until that Widerspruch is finally decided or withdrawn.

items.title: End of the 6-month Fahrtenbuch (logbook) duty
items.quote: Ich ordne daher an, dass Sie für dieses Fahrzeug für die Dauer von sechs Monaten ein Fahrtenbuch zu führen haben.
items.computation: Assuming Bestandskraft (and start of the 6-month duty) on 04.11.2026 (see previous item, itself an estimate), the six-month period under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB ends on the day with the same number six months later: 04.05.2027. This end date depends entirely on the uncertain start date above and is therefore only a rough estimate.

warnings: The exact start date of the 6-month Fahrtenbuch duty (and therefore its end date) cannot be determined with certainty from the letter, because it depends on Bestandskraft (legal finality) of the decision, which in turn depends on whether a Widerspruch is filed; the dates given for the logbook duty are estimates assuming no objection is raised.

The deemed delivery date (03.10.2026) falls on a Saturday; since the sender is a general district authority (Kreis) and not a tax office, this deemed-delivery day is not shifted to the next working day, per the applicable rule for non-tax authorities.
